guard.firstDraft: Sahi, answer sulfur hi hai; main repeat kar gayi. Ab sulfur ka ek alag use batayiye: matchsticks mein yeh kis kaam aata hai?

end.summary: Practised uses and physical states of common non-metals.
end.parentNote: Pari practised identifying non-metals by state and discussing oxygen in respiration, air, and hospitals. They used examples such as graphite, iodine crystals, sulfur in rubber, and sulfur’s yellow powder form. Sulfur was recalled repeatedly, while one classification question was left unanswered; no recorded misconception was noted. At home, ask Pari to sort the listed non-metals into solid, liquid, and gas, then name one use for each.

cards.ask: Do aise non-metals bataiye jo gas hain aur ek jo solid hai.
cards.answer: गैस वाले तो oxygen, nitrogen, hydrogen हैं और solid वाला carbon होता है जैसे पें

cards.ask: Khaali jagah bhariye: Air has about ___% oxygen, enough for a healthy person
cards.answer: इक्कीस परसेंट। मैंने तो अभी बताया ना, इक्कीस ही है। आपने सुना नहीं क्या फिर से?
